parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of email encoding with non-ASCII domain names by converting them to Punycode. The changes are minimal and focused on the relevant parts of the code.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new function `punycode` in `django/utils/encoding.py`, which could be considered a minor style inconsistency as it deviates from the existing naming conventions.
